profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (iOS) at American Express
profile.summary:
Engineer of Software, with 15 years of experience designing, implementing, testing and monitoring mobile, web, desktop and embedded software. In my first 8 years of professional career developed software for desktop computers using .NET Platforms in C#, web systems in ASP.NET, SQL and Silverlight and embedded systems in C. Learned iOS and for 10 years I have been building mobile Apps using Swift and Objective C, as well as taught myself Node JS and Javascript to construct web systems in React JS and cross-platform mobile Apps in React Native.
All these software are being developed using Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Lean, BDD and Kanban, Functional and Object Oriented paradigms, covered with tests, using version control, data structures, architectural and design patterns and the industry best practices while keeping the code readable, fast and clean. Paying special attention to customer satisfaction and building engaging products that delight users. 
Extended my knowledge beyond the Software development realm into the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment world by dedicating time to learn and develop CircleCI and GitHub platform integration solutions in Python, as well as monitoring solutions that keep the Team up to date with the latest developments of the tools that we have deployed to enhance developer experience.
I'm passionate about learning the latest technological and software engineering trends, I'm an avid reader and I'm always in the pursuit of self-improvement in this never stopping industry.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (iOS)
positions.description:
Intrinsic part of the Mobile Organization and member of a multidisciplinary Team of Product, Designers, Backend, QE and Engineers using Agile and Lean methodologies and practices like Kanban and Scrum.

Developing a highly performant and multithreaded Mobile App that directly impacts more than 10 million Card Members lives in more than 20 markets across the Globe

Practicing fundamental software architecture and programming design principles using Swift and Objective C as well as Functional, Reactive and Object Oriented paradigms. Keeping focus on quality, maintainablity, security and best practices of the code.

Maintain connection with a diverse array of sensors like Location, Touch/Face ID and back-end services using asynchronous network calls to RESTful APIs

Testing the functionality intensive and completely thru Unit, Snapshots and UI Tests using XCTest, FBSnapshot libraries as well as an array of tests helpers that avoid duplication while improving the readability, reliability and maintainability of the tests.

Kept code changes organized by continuously contributing to a Git repository core business code to a remote Bitbucket or GitHub version control system, organizing these changes in small PRs that contribute to keeping them constrained and clear to reviewers.

Monitored new code by closely working in an integrated environment of testing, build and deployment using GitHub and CircleCI. As well as updated and maintained core business Phyton scripts, GitHub Actions, Dependencies and CircleCI workflows that keep the CI/CD pipeline running smoothly and reliably.

Worked closely with third party open-source iOS ecosystem and libraries available for enriching user or development experience like ReactiveSwift, Anchorage, Adobe and Crashlytics analytics, SwiftFormat, SwiftLint, Danger, Tuist and many more and contributed to the open-source community that maintain these tools.

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Analyze user needs and design, implementation, testing and monitoring Apps for companies from Spain, Ecuador, Mexico and USA. Social, Education, Enterprise and Utilities apps using Xcode, Swift and iOS. Expert knowledge and understanding of data structures, OOP-Functional Programming principles and software architecture.

Exposure to overall software development life cycle, using Scrum as development methodology and DevOps principles. In an environment of cross functional teams of designers, QA and multi platform developers. Often times worked on some backend functionalities for the Apps created using Firebase and javascript.

Design or adapt Apps according with an usable and intuitive user interface experience in order to raise the maximum operational efficiency target as well as creating highly readable, testable and maintainable source code.

Experienced in Universal application development for devices including iPhone, iPad and Apple TV using UIKit, CoreAnimation and Auto-layout for smooth transitioning and better user experience. Custom UI implemented with XIBs. Extensively worked with StoryBoard, MapKit, CoreData, Multithreading, NSUserDefaults, NSNotifications, GCD and OperationQueue.

Developed RESTful web services in PHP, JavaScript and Firebase.

Worked on Apps with membership payment thru API services, goods sales and credit card manipulation with the required security, including Apple in app purchases.

Worked extensively with Swift and Cocoa frameworks, GIT & GITHUB as code version control, JIRA, Asana, Applause, Slack, GDB, Xcode debugging and Instruments tools.

Use of dependecy managers such as Cocoapods, Carthage and SPM . Most used 3rd party libraries AFNetworking, IQKeyboardManagerSwift, KMPlaceholderTextView, MBProgressHUD, SDWebImage, Firebase or ReachabilitySwift, Material.

Full-time student. Always learning and applying new knowledge such as React.js and React Native, Node.js, Redux, GraphQL, Firebase Remote functions.

positions.title: Project Manager & iOS Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design, development and testing of iOS applications using xCode, Mac OS X, iOS simulator, iPhone and iPad devices and Swift and objective C as a development language.
•	Obtaining and parsing JSON, XML data from RESTful API services using third-party libraries as AFnetworking.   
•	Project manager of En Percha App (iOS, Android and API) been part of all phases of the development life cycle. Using Scrum as a methodology, 2 week springs, daily scrum meetings, prioritizing and organizing user histories on JIRA and using GIT as a version control system. 
•	Management of iTunes Connect and Apple Member Center accounts of Kruger Corporation and	  La Favorita S.A. to publish and keep updated all company Apps on App Store.
•	Work-oriented to design and development of Mobile Applications (Sensors & camera, APNS, AutoLayout, UIKit, CoreData, CoreAnimation, CoreGraphics, CoreText, CFNetwork, AVFoundation, GCD, Unit Testing, UI Testing, xCode, iOS simulator, iPhone and iPad devices, Swift and objective C language, remote web services, CocoaPods, Notifications, JSON, XML, Mac OS X platform, JIRA, GIT, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Testflight, Crashlytics)

positions.title: Senior .NET Engineer
positions.description:
Design, development and test of Silverlight app for PRODUBANCO bank of Ecuador. This web application was made using WCF, XAML, ADO.NET with SQL Server and .NET 4.0 platform. Design and development of ASP.NET web application for human resources control. 

Used technologies: Silverlight, XAML, SQL Server 2008- 2014, WCF, Web & Windows Services Development & Deployment, ASP.NET Web Forms 4.0, .NET 4.0-4.5, ADO.NET, Crystal Reports, CSS, SQL SP, SQL Views, ADO.NET, Visual Studio 2008, 2010 and 2012.

positions.title: Project Manager & .NET Engineer
positions.description:
Direct, organize and evaluate a development Team. Software engineering, design, implementation and testing of medical devices control programs like Hipermax+ Ambulatory Blood Pressure using .NET platform and framework 3.5 and 4.0. Firmware programming in C for medical equipment constructed by the Enterprise. Present enterprise results and equipment in various medical and programming congress like CLAIB 2011 and Informatica Salud 2013.

Used technologies:.NET 3.5 and 4.0, Windows Forms 4.0, EF 4.0, SQLite, WPF, Visual Studio 2008 and 2010, USB Communications, C for firmware development over MSP430 microprocessor.

projects.title: What I Wore
projects.description:
WHAT i WORE is a visual calendar diary of what you wore, when.

Developed in Xcode, Swift 5 and Firebase. Used a unidirectional architecture, Coordinator pattern, Redux, VIPER and reusable components.

Main technologies: In App Purchases, OpenSSL, REST API
Third Party: Calendar, SwipeView, Cocoapods, Presentr
